intro.lead: Shirye-shiryen buɗaɗɗen tushe na masu haɓaka manhaja na nahiyar, da guraben da ƙungiyoyinsu ke nema. Tace ta matsayi, fasaha ko ƙasa: watakila gurbinka yana jiranka tun yanzu.

filters.label: Tace baje kolin
filters.unavailable: Babu shiri tare da sauran matatun

results.moreError: Sauran baje kolin bai iya lodawa ba.
results.noMatchTitle: Babu shirin da ya dace a yanzu
results.noMatchText: Cire matata ko gwada wata kalma. Idan kuma wannan shirin bai wanzu ba tukuna, ƙaddamar da shi: baje kolin yana jiransa.
results.publishTitle: Shirinka yana da gurbi a nan
results.publishText: Nuna abin da kake ginawa da matsayin da kake nema: masu haɓaka manhaja na nahiyar za su same ka a baje kolin.
